verdict.rationale: Asking whether a fraud-prevention SaaS publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, since vendors of this kind can open-source their core, SDKs, or plugins. The evidence mentions SDKs, a Beacon JavaScript snippet, and Magento/SFCC/Shopify integrations, but never says any of this code is public or under an open license. Absent such evidence, this applicable capability is unsupported.
